# workflow header
name: "Golden workflow"
description: |-
  Keep this multiline text.
  Exactly as authored.
settings: {retries: 2, mode: "careful"}
metadata:
  # owner guidance
  owner: old # edited owner
  untouched: "keep quoted" # keep this comment
nodes:
  # prepare comment
  - id: "prepare"
    command: |-
      printf 'prepare'
      printf 'again'
  - id: consume
    depends_on: ["prepare"]
    prompt: "Use $prepare.output.value"
    optional: keep-me
# workflow footer
